audit.whatIsWrong: Every one of the seven level-chart rows contradicted its own why text. The chart said Sett wins Level 1 while whys[0] says Ornn contests it better than most tanks; it said Ornn wins Level 3 and 4-5 while whys[2]/whys[3] call those even; it said Sett wins Level 6 while whys[4] says 'You own the 6'; it said Ornn wins 2+ items while whys[6] says Sett out-itemizes the duel.
audit.why: The prose read is mechanically right in every case, and the packet chart independently agrees with it row for row. Sett has no Haymaker and no Facebreaker at level 1-2, only Pit Grit punches; at 6 his R is a 400-range grab that Ornn's E knock-up off a Q pillar pre-empts; at two items Haymaker's true-damage core scales with the health he buys and ignores Ornn's armor.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Ornn, Ornn, Skill, Skill, Ornn, Skill, Sett across both layers, with ratings adjusted to match. Proposed as one atomic pair-group.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text was generic ('Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike', 'Sett's ultimate changes the math'). No cooldowns, no ranges.
audit.why: The real spikes are: Sett level 3 (Haymaker, 18s rank 1), Sett level 6 (The Show Stopper, 120s, 400 range), Ornn level 6 (double knock-up R, 140s), and Sett's health-item window where Haymaker's true core outscales armor stacking.
audit.corrected: Level 3, 4-5, 6, first item and 2+ item phase texts rewritten with the real numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two mechanics were stated wrong. (a) Haymaker was described flatly as 'true damage' — it is true damage in the centre only, physical on the sides. (b) Facebreaker was treated as a guaranteed stun ('Get E-stunned', 'his E grab can't pin you') — it stuns only if enemies are on opposite sides of him; against a lone Ornn it slows instead.
audit.why: Riot text, Haymaker: 'expends all stored Grit to gain a shield and punch an area, dealing true damage in the center and physical damage on the sides.' Facebreaker: 'pulls in all enemies on opposite sides of him, dealing damage and stunning them. If enemies were only on one side, they are slowed instead of stunned.' Both change the advice: stepping off-centre makes Ornn's armor stacking work again, and a solo Facebreaker is a slow, not a stun.
audit.corrected: Both stated explicitly in report[5], dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[2].d and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers, and Grit was never explained as something the player feeds.
audit.why: Haymaker 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s, Facebreaker 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s, The Show Stopper 120/100/80s at 400 range. Grit is stored from damage Sett takes, so chip poke that does not lead to a commit literally loads his shield and his punch.
audit.corrected: Numbers added; the grit-feeding logic tied to the Levels 4-5 phase.

audit.why: Pit Grit gives Sett bonus health regen scaling with missing health, so the existing early-anti-heal note in report[8] and breakdown.late is justified.

edits.before: Q-poke and AA-trade — your base stats are quietly elite. Identify how Sett contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Sett has no Haymaker and no Facebreaker yet — his only damage is the Pit Grit punch. Auto him back, shove, and take the level-1 tempo.

edits.before: W brittle turns every trade into bonus %HP damage. Only take the trade when Sett's Haymaker is down.
edits.after: Brittle from Bellows Breath's last gout adds %HP to every trade — and Sett still has no W or E to answer with.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Sett must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Haymaker is up and its centre is true damage — armor will not save you. Stand off-centre and you eat the physical edge instead.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Haymaker's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Haymaker is 18s at rank 1 and Grit is fed by the damage he takes — poke him only when you intend to follow through with E and W.

edits.before: Call of the Forge God re-engages a whole fight — and your forge prints item leads. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Sett's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: The Show Stopper needs him inside 400 units of you, so hold your E: knock him up off the Q pillar as he steps in and his 120s ult goes nowhere.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Haymaker's cooldown.
edits.after: Your tank item and his grit item land together — a coin-flip, so fight only with Haymaker spent.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Sett carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Sett out-duels you now: Haymaker scales with the health he buys and its true core ignores every point of armor you stacked. Group.

edits.before: Shield + true damage. Brittle-tank it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 18s at rank 1, and the true damage is only in the centre. Engage once it is spent.

edits.before: E-dashing with no terrain in the line — no knockup means you delivered yourself to his combo for free.
edits.after: Facebreaker stuns only with enemies on both sides of him — alone with you it just slows, so don't panic-Flash.

edits.before: Track Sett's Haymaker: Shield + true damage. Brittle-tank it. When it is down — W-E + R him.
edits.after: Haymaker's centre is true damage, the edges physical — step off-centre and your armor works.

edits.before: - Sett Haymaker: matchup-defining — Shield + true damage. Brittle-tank it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Sett Haymaker: 18s at rank 1 — shield plus true damage in the centre only. - Facebreaker: 16s, and it stuns only with enemies on both sides of him. - The Show Stopper: 120s at 400 range — stay outside it.

notes: UNVERIFIED, left alone: multiple content strings (whys[2], whys[3], mid, spikes[1], wants.you[1]) assert that Ornn's W grants a shield and makes him unstoppable mid-cast, and that this is why Facebreaker cannot pin him. Riot's kit text for Bellows Breath says only 'Ornn advances, breathing fire. Enemies hit by the final gout of flame become Brittle' — no shield, no unstoppable — and needsResearch is empty, so this is unknown rather than false. I did not repeat the claim in any string I rewrote and did not contradict it either. Same for 'R suppress' in whys[4]/spikes[2]: The Show Stopper's Riot text says carries and slams, not suppress. Note that the Facebreaker stun condition counts minions as enemies, so it is not a blanket 'he can never stun you' — my wording says 'alone with you', which is the safe form.
